title: Systematic review of training-free neural architecture search: research progress, core challenges, and future directions
title_zh: 无训练神经网络架构搜索的系统综述：研究进展、核心挑战与未来方向
abstract: Abstract Neural Architecture Search (NAS) serves as a performance engine for automated machine learning, driving intelligent advancements across various domains. However, its development has been significantly constrained by the prohibitively high computational costs involved. Training-Free Neural Architecture Search (TFNAS) addresses this bottleneck by enabling rapid architecture evaluation through extremely low-cost proxy metrics, where “training-free" refers to the absence of candidate network training during the search loop, and its broader interpretation permits offline pre-training of lightweight predictors that do not constitute search-stage training. This paper presents a systematic, critical review of TFNAS. First, the core concepts and practical advantages of TFNAS are revisited, defining it as a distinct and emerging research paradigm. Second, a two-dimensional taxonomy is proposed based on the source of information and the construction methodology of proxy metrics, aiming to clarify the developmental trajectory of state-of-the-art techniques in this field. Furthermore, this work delves into the evolutionary mechanism involving the co-development of evaluation metrics and search strategies, positing that the joint optimization characterized by dynamic feedback and mutual reinforcement is key to maximizing efficacy. Finally, this review reveals four core contradictions that persist as the technology progresses toward practical application and outlines future directions. This review offers valuable references and conceptual inspiration for the maturation of TFNAS, laying a solid foundation for its reliable and widely applicable real-world deployment.
abstract_zh: 摘要：神经网络架构搜索（NAS）是自动机器学习的性能引擎，推动了各领域的智能进步。然而，其发展受到极高计算成本的显著限制。无训练神经网络架构搜索（TFNAS）通过极低成本的代理指标实现快速架构评估，解决了这一瓶颈，其中“无训练”指在搜索循环中不对候选网络进行训练，且更广义的解释允许在离线预训练轻量级预测器，而这些预测器不构成搜索阶段的训练。本文对TFNAS进行了系统且批判性的综述。首先，重新审视了TFNAS的核心概念和实际优势，将其定义为一个独立且新兴的研究范式。其次，提出了基于信息来源和代理指标构建方法的二维分类法，旨在阐明该领域最先进技术的发展轨迹。进一步地，本文深入探讨了评估指标与搜索策略共同演化的机制，认为由动态反馈和相互强化特征的联合优化是最大化效能的关键。最后，综述揭示了技术向实际应用推进过程中仍存的四个核心矛盾，并概述了未来的发展方向。本综述为TFNAS的成熟提供了宝贵的参考和概念启示，为其可靠且广泛应用的现实部署奠定了坚实基础。
